findings.summary: Fingerprint comparison uses Data equality and is not constant-time; acceptable because fingerprints are public material.
TrustPolicyState.trusted(fingerprint:) can structurally carry wrong-length Data; decide always rejects it with trustRejected before comparison.

Prompt UI, persistence and TLS wiring are outside M1-057; integrators must never map prompt to MacTLSTrustDecision.accept. Covered by already-planned M1-058/M1-059 integration work; no new follow-up issue required.
